statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Tail remains elevated as the technology-led decline has extended modestly after the open amid broad semiconductor weakness, firmer volatility, high long-term yields and elevated oil.
recommendation: Policy mapping remains BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES while Tail is elevated; normalization depends on evidence of meaningful retracements, reduced directional efficiency and cross-asset stabilization.
headline: Technology-led decline keeps Tail above the block threshold
body: The Nasdaq was about 1.2% lower in the latest verified live-market update after being down 1.04% shortly after the open. Semiconductor weakness remained broad, while long Treasury yields, volatility and oil stayed elevated. The observed extension is meaningful, but limited independent bar-level evidence of repeated failed retracements keeps Tail in the high-20s.
